Performers
Czech National Symphony Orchestra (as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra) (orchestra) Documented

The Commons description names the orchestra. No conductor is named in the sources consulted.

[1]
Work version
Orchestral concert version from Suite No. 1, without chorus Inferred, not documented

The Musopen listing is for Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46; the edition is not identified.

[1] [2]
Recorded
2012 Documented

Commons dates the file 7 April 2012 without saying whether that is the session, release or upload date; the Musopen Kickstarter project that paid for the recording completed in 2012. Only the year is used.

[1] [2]
Place
Unknown Unknown

No venue or city is given for the session.

[1] [2]
Label
Musopen (Kickstarter-funded recording project) Documented

Musopen is a non-profit that raised money by Kickstarter to record music and release it to the public domain.

[1] [2]
Catalogue
Unknown Unknown

The Internet Archive compilation has no catalogue number.

[1] [2]
Transfer
Uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by user Yodin Documented

Commons file history; no mastering engineer is named.

[1]
Transfer date
2012-10-14 Documented

Commons upload date, not a session date.

[1]
Processing
Ogg Vorbis file on Commons; MP3 access derivative generated by Commons Documented

No editing or normalisation by Contrapunctus; one complete source stream.

[1]
Composition rights
Public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms Inferred, not documented

Grieg died on 4 September 1907. This says nothing about any modern edition.

[1] [3]
Recording rights
Public domain by Musopen’s release (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark); Commons tags the file {{PD-author}} for Musopen Documented

The Internet Archive compilation of the Musopen Kickstarter recordings carries the Public Domain Mark. Commons quotes Musopen’s requirement that uploaders warrant that content is in the public domain.

[1] [2]

Edvard Grieg, In the Hall of the Mountain King (Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46); Czech National Symphony Orchestra as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra, Musopen Kickstarter Project, 2012. Public domain; via Wikimedia Commons. No audio edits. Rights statement

Wikimedia Commons — Musopen, In the Hall Of The Mountain King — Description: performed by the Czech National Symphony Orchestra as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra for the Musopen Kickstarter Project; date 2012-04-07; licence tag PD-author (Musopen); uploaded 14 October 2012 by Yodin.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  2. Internet Archive — Musopen Kickstarter Music (lossless DVD compilation) — Date 2012-08; licence URL: Public Domain Mark 1.0; description lists “Grieg - Peer Gynt” among the music recorded and released into the public domain; the project completed in 2012.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  3. Finn Benestad — Edvard Grieg, Norsk biografisk leksikon — Dates: died 4 September 1907; Peer Gynt music 1874–⁠75, Suite No. 1 published as Op. 46 in 1888 with “I Dovregubbens hall” as its fourth piece.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
